bio: The distinctive sound of fine natural wine “glug glugging” into a glass is the hallmark of this friendly eatery. Let yourself be guided by the expert insights of the sommelier. The chef, for his part, showcases his personal take on contemporary tapas, mingling French, Asian and Italian influences with enthusiasm and generosity. Full-bodied soy flanks aubergine, while fresh, spicy kimchi jazzes up beef hanger steak without forgetting the irresistible lost bread. Everything is impossibly tempting –don’t forget to book!...
